components.name: Pagination
components.description:
Figma Pagination (774:29083). Button/Icon-Main XSmall Tertiary ‹ › (icon-chevron-*-line-small) around the
content, Spacing/Gap/Medium between groups; Pages gap Spacing/Gap/2XSmall; Inline/Manually navigator gap XSmall.
The arrows follow `size` (Figma draws XSmall only): XSmall items (24, Select-Item/Size/Small) keep Icon-Main XSmall
(Button/Size/XSmall), Small items (32, Select-Item/Size/Medium) take Icon-Main Small (Button/Size/Small), so the
arrows always match the items in both densities.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new 1-based page when ‹ › or a page item is pressed.

props.name: onPageChange
props.description: Called with the new page number (1-based). `onValueChange` is the same callback under the name value controls share.

props.name: theme
props.description: Primary/Secondary: numbered items. Inline: page-size Chip + range label. Manually: page-size Input + range label.

props.name: pageCount
props.description: Number of pages (Primary/Secondary). For Inline/Manually it is derived from `total` / `pageSize`.

props.name: pageSize
props.description: Items per page and total items (Inline/Manually).

props.name: size
props.description: Page items and the ‹ › arrows: xs = 24px (Figma) · sm = 32px. Short (xs, sm) or Figma (xsmall, small) spelling.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the navigation landmark. Default: the locale's “Pagination”.

components.name: PaginationItem
components.description: Figma .Primitives/Pagination/Item (774:15999). The ellipsis renders as a non-interactive item.

props.name: size
props.description: Figma Size: XSmall 24 (Select-Item/Size/Small) · Small 32 (Select-Item/Size/Medium). Short (sm, md…) or Figma (small, medium…) spelling.

props.name: level
props.description: Selected fill: Primary Active/Neutral/Solid (Inverse label) · Secondary Active/Neutral/Subtle.

props.name: optional
props.description: Narrow screens hide optional pages (everything but first, last and current), keeping `1 … 5 … 12`.
